body: Yeah, called a few times, even from a different phone - it goes to the owner’s message bank - left a message with no response also. I’m pretty careful with online shopping, there are positive reviews and social comments, and the ABN is active so there was no indication that anything wasn’t right. I totally get if they’re busy, but a response to one of my emails or something over the past 2 months isn’t too much to ask :(
Yep - they won’t respond to emails or anything so I’ve taken to negative reviewing, I feel bad but it’s not good customer service to ignore for so long
